scopeGuardrail: This catalog is triage assistance at the bound assembly SHA. It maps proof failures to likely owners; source inspection is not a behavioral verdict and never substitutes for live proof.

canonicalPersistence.note: TaskFlow and the SQLite delivery queue are authoritative across restart; process timer maps are hedges only.

tool-registration.purpose: Gate and register the typed continuation tools for an agent run.

delegate-input.purpose: Validate typed continue_delegate task, delay, mode, targeting, fanout, model, attachment, and managed-return input before durable admission.

delegate-durable-dispatch.purpose: Persist delegate intent in TaskFlow, enforce policy and budgets, then spawn an idempotently named child.

delegate-return.purpose: Route one child completion to the intended session set through durable, idempotent delivery and optional trusted wake.

delegate-chain.purpose: Fold child token use into chain state, drain child-owned delegates, preserve silent/wake inheritance, and account for nested hops.

token-parser.purpose: Parse and strip the final winning CONTINUE_WORK or CONTINUE_DELEGATE bracket signal without exposing hidden trace state.

model-routing.purpose: Resolve explicit or inherited provider/model selection and persist the authoritative child session metadata used by proof receipts.

post-compaction.purpose: Stage post-compaction delegates durably and release them only after a confirmed compaction boundary.

work-scheduling.purpose: Capture each continue_work election and create one durable same-session wake with bounded delay.

work-execution.purpose: Grant, fire, retry, supersede, and terminally settle durable continuation work exactly once.

startup-recovery.purpose: Recover durable delegate and work rows on gateway startup, with delegate recovery ordered first.

runtime-config.purpose: Define, validate, and resolve the canonical continuation configuration and defaults.

request-compaction.purpose: Apply the 70% context guard, per-session cooldown, in-flight dedupe, and asynchronous compaction request lifecycle.

observability.purpose: Emit public-safe chain spans, queue diagnostics, and status output without exporting raw task/reason text or raw recipient keys.
